name: Baphomet
source:
Zeabolos’ butler who serves as the Underworld’s minister.

He has been a butler since the era of the first Great Overlord, and is a walking encyclopedia of the Underworld’s history, including the existence of Trillion.

He is somewhat overprotective of Zeabolos, as he has taken care of him since childhood.
